description: This file defines the API endpoint for managing vacancy attachments within the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting attachments related to job vacancies and uses various API components, validation rules, and entity models.

classes.name: VacancyAttachmentAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing vacancy attachments, providing methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting attachments associated with job vacancies.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Placeholder method for retrieving all attachments; currently not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll method; currently not implemented.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creating a new vacancy attachment, including validating input, setting attachment details, and saving to the database.

methods.name: setVacancyAttachment
methods.description: Sets vacancy attachment properties from request parameters, including vacancy ID, comment, and attachment type.

methods.name: setBase64Attachment
methods.description: Sets file-related properties of the attachment from a base64-encoded input.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new attachment request.

methods.name: getAttachmentRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for the attachment data, specifically for base64 input.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Returns common validation rules for optional request parameters such as comment and attachment type.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified vacancy attachments by IDs provided in the request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete operation, mainly for IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves all attachments for a specific vacancy by its ID.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachments
methods.description: Private method that fetches attachments and count for a specific vacancy ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rule to ensure the vacancy ID exists and is positive.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing vacancy attachment, optionally replacing the file content.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating an attachment, including ID validation and optional file replacement.

methods.name: getRecruitmentAttachment
methods.description: Converts a VacancyAttachment entity into a RecruitmentAttachment DTO for API response.
